title: The Tide Bell
text: A bell rings under the water when the tide turns, a sweet and lonely sound. The sea people say it calls home anyone who hears it, and the shore is lined with footprints walking into the waves. None walk out.

options.label: The one with the sea in them answers the bell, and trusts it to let them go.

outcomes.text: They come back with salt in their hair and calm in their eyes.
They nearly do not come back, and come back harder.

options.label: The hardiest dives for the bell, to silence its call for good.

outcomes.text: The sea people take it badly.

options.label: Stop your ears and go, before anyone walks into the waves.

outcomes.text: It rings anyway, in your dreams, and in the dreams you walk toward it.
